She steps out from the family cottage carrying one small travel bag.

Her sword is secured at her side.

Father is standing outside near the cottage.

Riven sees him.

Father sees Riven.

They share a brief silent look.

Neither character approaches for an embrace.

Neither character gives a farewell speech.

Riven gives Father a small acknowledging nod.

Then Riven turns toward the village road.

She begins walking away.

Father remains beside the cottage.

He does not follow her.

"Riven."

She turns and looks back at him.

"Remember who you fight for."

She continues walking away from the cottage.

Father remains behind.

"Riven."
